about: Touched-path → test-suite map (bothouse#236), read by `botq test-map`. Every landed change must show the commands its touched paths map to, green. First matching rule wins: specific rules above broad ones. `tests: []` means CONSCIOUSLY untested and must carry its why. An unmapped path fails the resolver loud. Commands run from the repo root; lint completeness with `botq test-map --check`.

rules.why: prose, the licence, the kids' requirement drawings, and this manifest itself — no code to exercise
the dev environment and CI definition: every mapped suite below runs inside the nix shell, so a break in it fails those commands loudly, and the workflow proves itself by running on push

one small crate whose modules interlock (the mesher reads the world, the wire format reads the registry), so scoping per-module would miss exactly the cross-module breakage that matters; --test-threads=2 because bothouse's cores are usually contended and the chunk-meshing tests are allocation-heavy
